chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said:

Indeed, Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said to him: These companions of ours have refused to increase in their salat (prayer) during the month of Ramaḍān, while the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم did increase in his salat (prayer) during the month of Ramaḍān.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the speaker in the report
key_terms.أَصْحَابَنَا: our companions; the followers referred to in the narration
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, the sacred month in which the practice is discussed
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِمْ: their salat (prayer), referring to their devotional practice

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم increase his salat (prayer) in the month of Ramaḍān?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement from Imam Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام concerning increasing salat (prayer) in the month of Ramaḍān. It presents this increase as something done by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, indicating its relevance in discussions of devotional practice and prayer rulings in Ramaḍān.
